items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch against the 2024 income tax assessment
items.quote: Ihr Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats eingelegt werden; die Monatsfrist rechnet vom Ende des Tages an, an dem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist.
items.computation: Bescheid dated/posted 17.03.2025 (Monday). Posted on/after 1 Jan 2025, so the Bekanntgabefiktion is the 4th day after posting (letter itself states this): day of posting (17.03) not counted, counting 4 days gives 18.03, 19.03, 20.03, 21.03 → deemed delivered Friday, 21.03.2025. For Finanzamt letters, if this 4th day fell on a weekend/holiday it would move to the next working day (§108 Abs.3 AO), but 21.03.2025 is a Friday, so delivery stays 21.03.2025. The one-month Einspruch period under §355 Abs.1 AO, counted per §108 Abs.1 AO / §188 Abs.2 BGB, runs from the day after delivery and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 21.04.2025. That day, 21 April 2025, is Easter Monday (Ostermontag), a nationwide public holiday, so under §108 Abs.3 AO the deadline moves to the next working day: Tuesday, 22.04.2025.
